2608.12197.title: NetlistBench: Evaluating LLM Reliability in SPICE Netlist Recognition and Manipulation
2608.12197.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in circuit design workflows, yet their reliability on simulator-facing SPICE netlist recognition and manipulation remains poorly understood and is rarely separated from high-level design reasoning. Although netlists are textual, they encode structured circuit objects through topology and parameters. We present \textbf{NetlistBench}, a structure-verified benchmark for SPICE netlist recognition and manipulation. NetlistBench contains 2,342 cases across 24 task families, covering parameter and connectivity recognition and edits, hierarchical operations, equivalence judgment, and long-horizon compound editing. Model outputs are evaluated by a deterministic structure-aware oracle. Across six non-thinking LLMs, performance varies substantially with operation-level structural complexity. Simple local edits reach $96\%$--$100\%$ accuracy, while device addition drops to $41\%$--$83\%$ and equivalence judgment to $49\%$--$90\%$. Enabling reasoning substantially improves weaker models but does not eliminate structure-preservation failures, with performance still degrading sharply as the edit horizon increases. NetlistBench identifies netlist reliability as a distinct bottleneck for trustworthy LLM-based circuit design automation.
2608.12197.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在電路設計工作流程中的應用日益增多，但它們在面向模擬器的SPICE網路清單識別和操作方面的可靠性仍然不甚了解，且很少與高階設計推理分開考量。儘管網路清單是文本格式的，但它們通過拓撲和參數編碼結構化的電路物件。我們提出了\textbf{NetlistBench}，這是一個經結構驗證的SPICE網路清單識別和操作基準測試。NetlistBench包含2,342個案例，涵蓋24個任務類別，包括參數和連接性識別及編輯、層次操作、等價判斷和長期復合編輯。模型輸出由一個確定性的結構感知預言機進行評估。在六個非思考型LLM中，性能因操作層級的結構複雜性而有顯著變化。簡單的局部編輯達到$96\%$--$100\%$的準確率，而設備添加降至$41\%$--$83\%$，等價判斷則降至$49\%$--$90\%$。啟用推理顯著改善了較弱的模型，但並未消除結構保留失敗，隨著編輯範圍的增加，性能仍然急劇下降。NetlistBench將網路清單的可靠性確定為基於LLM的可信電路設計自動化的一個明顯瓶頸。
